title: Syndicated refinancing
description: Act as the deal execution team for a digital infrastructure refinancing. Bring together due diligence, financing terms, financial models, and lender feedback into a coherent package for signing preparation.

tasks.label: Financial due diligence
tasks.uses: Financial records and late diligence evidence.
tasks.produces: An earnings-quality report with the adopted earnings basis and unresolved reconciliation items.

tasks.label: Environmental & insurance review
tasks.produces: A review that distinguishes confirmed coverage and permissions from outstanding conditions.

tasks.label: Technical due diligence
tasks.uses: Technical records for the asset portfolio and network.
tasks.produces: Asset assessments with capital-expenditure risks, cost evidence and remaining uncertainties.

tasks.label: Tax structuring
tasks.uses: Tax records and the proposed ownership structure.
tasks.produces: A tax memo explaining the relevant scenario and the limits of its application.

tasks.label: Lender presentation
tasks.uses: The agent’s financial, environmental, technical and tax diligence.
tasks.produces: A lender presentation bringing together debt-service capacity, financing proposals and open issues.

tasks.label: Committee pre-read
tasks.uses: The lender presentation, supporting diligence and unresolved execution conditions.
tasks.produces: A committee pre-read that identifies decisions, alternatives and conditions for proceeding.

tasks.label: Financing terms
tasks.uses: Earlier financing analysis, committee issues, lender feedback and management comments.
tasks.produces: A revised term sheet for modelling, internal review and further lender discussions.

tasks.label: Core financial model
tasks.uses: Financing terms, technical risks and the applicable tax assumptions, checked against source evidence.
tasks.produces: A recalculating financing model with traceable assumptions and debt-service calculations.

tasks.label: Scenario models
tasks.uses: The agent’s own core financial model.
tasks.produces: Two scenario models, an assumptions memo and a record of the changes actually made.

tasks.label: Committee & lender materials
tasks.uses: Scenario results, the earlier committee pack and current financing terms, alongside new board decisions.
tasks.produces: A final committee pack, a lender invitation and a working-group status note for their respective audiences.

tasks.label: Syndication update
tasks.uses: Scenario analysis, invitation materials and open conditions, plus new orders and lender clarification questions.
tasks.produces: A syndication report answering the questions, updating execution status and identifying changes still needed.

tasks.label: Valuation references
tasks.uses: Market evidence, model assumptions and current financing status. Financing context does not replace independent market evidence.
tasks.produces: A valuation-multiples summary that states the applicability and limits of each method.

tasks.label: Final handoff
tasks.uses: The agent’s models, assumptions, syndication update and valuation summary, together with current terms and signing instructions.
tasks.produces: A six-file handoff with the current arrangements and outstanding conditions clearly identified.

feedback.label: Lender clarification questions
feedback.uses: The agent’s actual lender presentation, financing terms and invitation materials.
feedback.produces: Business clarification questions that the agent must address in the syndication update. These questions do not themselves approve or change financing terms.
